reason: A web UI skin that changes DSH colors, backgrounds, panel transparency, and decorative styling for light and dark themes.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供粉白配色、赛博霓虹装饰、角色背景图和浅深色双主题的视觉皮肤。
summaries.en: A DSH Web UI skin providing pink-and-white colors, cyber-neon accents, a character background image, and light and dark themes.

capabilities: Applies light and dark visual themes to the DSH Web UI
Overrides UI color and layout-related CSS variables
Serves and displays a bundled background image through a static route
Adds translucent panels and visual decorations to the web interface
